description: Source code for a graphical configuration tool 'qconf' using Qt, implementing UI components, settings management, and main application logic.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Manages application settings storage and retrieval.

classes.name: ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents a configuration item in the UI, including its display and update logic.

classes.name: ConfigItemDelegate
classes.description: Custom delegate for editing ConfigItem data in views.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: A Qt widget representing a list/tree of configuration options.

classes.name: ConfigInfoView
classes.description: Displays detailed info about a selected configuration symbol or menu.

classes.name: ConfigMainWindow
classes.description: Main application window managing the overall UI and interactions.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Updates the display of a menu entry based on its current state.

methods.name: testUpdateMenu
methods.description: Tests and updates the menu item display if changed.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructs a menu entry.

methods.name: ~ConfigItem
methods.description: Destructor for ConfigItem, cleans up linked list.

methods.name: createEditor
methods.description: Creates an editor widget for in-place editing of configuration data.

methods.name: setModelData
methods.description: Sets data from editor into the model, updating the symbol value.

methods.name: reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes the list view based on current settings.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves current UI state to persistent storage.

methods.name: updateSelection
methods.description: Updates the current selection and emits relevant signals.

methods.name: updateList
methods.description: Refreshes the list of configuration items displayed.

methods.name: setRootMenu
methods.description: Sets the root menu for the list view.

methods.name: setParentMenu
methods.description: Navigates to the parent menu.

methods.name: updateMenuList
methods.description: Recursively updates child menu entries in the view.

methods.name: keyPressEvent
methods.description: Handles key events for navigation and toggling options.

methods.name: mousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events.

methods.name: mouseReleaseEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse release events, including toggling options.

methods.name: mouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse move events.

methods.name: mouseDoubleClickEvent
methods.description: Handles double-click events for expanding or editing options.

methods.name: focusInEvent
methods.description: Handles focus events.

methods.name: contextMenuEvent
methods.description: Displays context menu.
